digest.component_or_area: store git operations (local lock contention handling)
propositions: Local git call sites lack bounded contention policies and are unbounded in the case of index-lock, HEAD.lock, and packed-refs.lock conflicts.
Concurrent rebar agent processes contend on shared tracker git operations; transient lock conflicts surface as errors instead of being silently absorbed via retry.
High-contention scenarios with many local agents need per-store advisory locking plus jittered backoff retry to absorb transient conflicts and surface only permanently-held-lock errors.
Index-mutating store git operations route through a shared seam (_with_index_lock_retry) and event append stages compose multiple lock-held git calls; both must inherit bounded retry semantics.
Watchdog timeouts (120s for plumbing, 300s for slow paths) distinguish wedged filesystems from legitimately slow work without aborting mid-write.
